description: Skill catalog used by the skill-selection corpus tests. Mirrors the skills the agent actually learns in a household (one reading/status workflow, several device-control workflows, and soft-domain workflows).

skills.title: Look up sensor or entity status
skills.description: Parameterized status lookup for a reading in a room (temperature, humidity, air quality, energy).
skills.body: Search for the sensor, then read its state.

skills.title: Turn lights on or off
skills.description: Switch or dim lights in a room.
skills.body: Find the light entity, then call the light service.

skills.title: Open or close covers and blinds
skills.description: Open, close, or position covers, blinds, shades, and shutters.
skills.body: Find the cover entity, then call the cover service.

skills.title: Lock or unlock doors
skills.body: Find the lock entity, then call the lock service.

skills.title: Set the thermostat target temperature
skills.description: Change the heating or cooling target on a thermostat.
skills.body: Find the climate entity, then set the target temperature.

skills.title: Control music and media players
skills.description: Play, pause, skip, and change volume on media players.
skills.body: Find the media player, then call the media service.

skills.title: Send a camera snapshot to a phone
skills.description: Grab a still image from a camera and send it to a phone or tablet.
triggers: send a picture from the {{query}} camera to my phone
snapshot the {{query}} camera and text it to me
show me who is at the door on my phone
skills.body: Grab the camera image, then send it with the notify service.

skills.title: Send a notification to a phone
skills.description: Push a message or alert to a phone, tablet, or speaker.
triggers: send a notification to my phone
let me know when {{query}} is done
skills.body: Call the notify service for the target device.

skills.title: Run a scene or routine
skills.description: Activate a scene, script, or multi-device routine such as movie mode or bedtime.
skills.body: Find the scene or script, then activate it.

skills.title: Check and read unread emails
skills.description: Check the inbox and summarize unread email messages.
skills.body: Search the mailbox for unread messages, then summarize them.

skills.title: Daily news briefing
skills.description: Curate headlines into a short briefing.
skills.body: Curate headlines from the configured feeds.
